Name: AT - Infinite Possibilities Carpeting
Author: CrypticHaze
Description:
I made five options; Cobblestone Path, Crystal Path, Gravel Path, Stepping Stone Path, and Wood Path. Just delete the folders for the ones you don't want or keep them all. They all have the same 54 variations of carpeting in each folder. Use the Paint Bucket available from Robin to recolor the path after you put it where you want.

You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url] to force the flooring to go over or under difficult placements, like the spot in spouse rooms be warned this can also delete an object even chests so move them first.

Manifest.Name: Infinite Possibilities Carpeting
Manifest.Description: Make carpets of any shape and size anywhere you want.
